hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -q -m "auto: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; fi && if [ "$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD)" -gt 0 ]; then git push -q origin main; fi
